newsitem.title: UK: Access Plus comes to AIM with 12.6 million tag.
newsitem.headline: Access Plus comes to AIM with 12.6 million tag.

text.p: Access Plus Plc, a marketing services group, said on Wednesday it had completed a placing of ordinary shares at 90p, valuing it at 12.6 million stg.
Dealing in the shares is expected to commence on the Alternative Investment Market on November 25.

The Bristol-based company, which holds a royal warrant, provides design and project management services in three main areas: direct mail, business forms and special and security products such as cheques and gift vouchers.
The adviser to the placing was Brown, Shipley & Co.
